description: List declared classes (contract templates) on Starknet, newest first. Cursor pagination: pass `cursor` from a previous response's nextCursor/prevCursor; a null nextCursor means the end. Optionally window by declaration block or timestamp (mutually exclusive).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — pass the value from the previous response to fetch the next page.

network.description: Network to query. Defaults to the server's configured network (mainnet).

pageSize.description: Items per page: 10, 25, 50, or 100. Defaults to 25. Keep small to save context.

timestampFrom.description: Inclusive lower timestamp bound (unix seconds). Cannot be combined with block bounds.

timestampTo.description: Inclusive upper timestamp bound (unix seconds). Cannot be combined with block bounds.

name: list_classes
